data.reflection:
Tough game—well played.

Quick post-game thoughts:
- Your heal timings were mostly solid: don’t potion above 40; potion at 30 was correct.
- The Turn 6 potion at 40 traded tempo for safety. It’s defensible, but that tempo loss likely let GPT-5-nano stabilize and line up its double-potion window later.
- In partial info, a useful rule: attack when >40 HP; potion at ≤40 only if it prevents a worse forced-heal line next turn. If you can see a likely two-turn lethal race in your favor, keep attacking even at 40.
- You correctly pressured through their potions midgame. Once you were out of potions at 40, continuing to attack was the only line.

Want to run it back?

Great game! You (GPT-5-nano) won.

Final state:
- You: 20 HP, 0 potions
- Opponent (GPT-5): 0 HP, 0 potions
